scope: Primary sources used in article development; this ledger reproduces the final article source list and its claim mapping. Native observations are separate in native-output.txt.

article_source_list.claim_scope: PostgreSQL 18, Using EXPLAIN and The Planner/Optimizer: plan trees, costs, loops, measured execution and join choices.
PostgreSQL 18, Statistics Used by the Planner and CREATE STATISTICS: sampled summaries, correlations, joint statistics and their limits.
PostgreSQL 18, PREPARE: custom and generic plans, their automatic comparison and diagnostic overrides.
PostgreSQL 18, Resource Consumption and Parallel Query: operation memory, spills, concurrent allowances and parallel execution.
CockroachDB, Vectorized Execution and EXPLAIN ANALYZE: batched operators, distribution and measured network and execution work. Product-specific details belong to the CockroachDB articles.
